title: Rows request
description: One logical line, the width of the box it is drawn in, and where a row is allowed to end.

text.description: One logical line. A newline inside it is an ordinary character, not a row boundary: a caller holding several lines splits them first.

cols.description: Width of the box in monospace columns, where an emoji or an ideograph fills two and a combining mark none. Zero is legal and means a window mid-resize; the whole line then reports one row.

break.description: column: every row is filled to cols columns, mid-word or not, which is what a caret placed as row * cols + column needs. word: a row ends at the last break opportunity that fits, and only a word wider than the whole box breaks on the column.
